lines: Zayan runs fast to burn energy, determined to get his favorite glowing ball from inside.
When his locker combination slips away, Zayan snaps his rubber band to help his busy mind focus.
Locked inside a shifting maze, Zayan stays calm while his brain starts tracking the moving walls.
His fast brain spots the thirty-second pattern, giving him the confidence to lead everyone to safety.
Tracking the glowing floor lights, Zayan easily finds the safe path before the walls even shift.
Three spinning metal rings block their escape, but Zayan uses his intense focus to find the opening.
They burst outside safely, and Zayan celebrates by running laps to release his endless energy.
With his glowing ball safe, Zayan happily sprints across the playground, proud of his amazing, energetic brain.
